verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a real Webhook API: real-time HTTP notifications of platform changes, delivered to a user-created HTTPS endpoint, with subscriptions to multiple event categories. However, the only event type the evidence names is payment status (success or failure), not the data-freshness events this story asks for. missing for 10: evidence of webhook signing or signature verification, documented events for new transactions, balance updates and connection/consent state changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
